replication.target_description: Experiment 2: UCSD online adult panel participants; honesty versus neutral primes; mean proportion of four excessive-alcohol behavior questions endorsed; independent-groups t test.

n.quote: Data were obtained from 70 participants in the honesty condition and 82 participants in the neutral condition.
n.sample_role: Participants in the two-condition drinking-response test
n.exclusions: No exclusions in primary analysis; first 38 nonrandomly assigned participants retained. Separate 114-person sensitivity analysis not selected.

reported_success.quote: None of the studies provided any evidence that honesty priming increases candor of responding.

notes: Original full primary paper unavailable: DOI landing not accessible; CiteSeer PDF returned 404/timeout; Unpaywall and OpenAlex report no open-access location. Original statistics quoted secondarily in replication paper were not used. Supplied replication page locators appear to refer to a manuscript rather than the six-page published article.
